method: Unchanged original classes on the PlayerDamageProbe world double (Normal, air everywhere, en_US.lang loaded from the jar). The victim is the real EntityPlayerMP (profile name Player; PvP enabled on the stub server). Each record is a list of timed ops (see CombatTrackerProbe.java header): hits go through attackEntityFrom so the real EntityLivingBase.damageEntity feeds CombatTracker.func_94547_a; ticksExisted advances per tick and func_94549_h runs every 20 ticks. preview is CombatTracker.func_151521_b after each hit; message is what EntityPlayerMP.onDeath broadcasts on a fatal hit. Messages are ChatComponentTranslation key, argument texts and the localised text.
